quests.hint: What device gives your phone battery power?
quests.explanation: A charger refills a device's battery through a cable. Forgetting one is a common modern travel problem.
quests.textToSpeak: I forgot to pack my phone charger for the trip.
quests.question: I forgot to pack my phone _____ for the trip.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes having a bad reaction to certain foods?
quests.explanation: Allergic describes a strong negative reaction to food or pollen. Checking labels is a smart safety habit.
quests.textToSpeak: He is allergic to peanuts, so he checks every label.
quests.question: He is _____ to peanuts, so he checks every label.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: Whose job is it to make people laugh on stage?
quests.explanation: A comedian performs jokes to entertain people. 'Made the whole audience laugh' shows a very successful show.
quests.textToSpeak: The comedian made the whole audience laugh for an hour.
quests.question: The _____ made the whole audience laugh for an hour.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What machine turns computer files into paper copies?
quests.explanation: A printer turns digital documents into paper copies. 'Ran out of paper' is a common office annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: The office printer ran out of paper again.
quests.question: The office _____ ran out of paper again.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What pain do you feel inside your head?
quests.explanation: A headache is common pain in the head. 'Took a tablet' is the natural response to this problem.
quests.textToSpeak: She took a tablet because she had a bad headache.
quests.question: She took a tablet because she had a bad _____.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: Who is the crowd watching a live performance?
quests.explanation: An audience is the crowd watching a concert or play. Thanking them is a polite way to end a performance.
quests.textToSpeak: The singer thanked the audience at the end of the show.
quests.question: The singer thanked the _____ at the end of the show.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What secret code do you need to access your account?
quests.explanation: A password protects your account from others. 'Couldn't log in' shows a common frustration when we forget one.
quests.textToSpeak: He couldn't log in because he forgot his password.
quests.question: He couldn't log in because he forgot his _____.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What substance treats an illness or eases pain?
quests.explanation: Medicine treats illness and is often taken on a schedule. 'Twice a day with food' is a typical instruction on a label.
quests.textToSpeak: Take this medicine twice a day with food.
quests.question: Take this _____ twice a day with food.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What is the music played throughout a film called?
quests.explanation: A soundtrack is the collection of music used in a film. Sometimes it becomes more famous than the film itself.
quests.textToSpeak: The soundtrack of the film became more popular than the movie.
quests.question: The _____ of the film became more popular than the movie.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a new version of an app with fixes?
quests.explanation: An update improves an app, often fixing problems. 'Install... tonight' suggests it's a routine, low-effort task.
quests.textToSpeak: Please install the latest software update tonight.
quests.question: Please install the latest software _____ tonight.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What physical activity keeps you fit and improves sleep?
quests.explanation: Exercise keeps your body fit and can improve sleep. 'Regular' means done often, not just once.
quests.textToSpeak: Regular exercise helps you sleep better at night.
quests.question: Regular _____ helps you sleep better at night.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes one part of a TV series?
quests.explanation: An episode is a single installment of a TV series. Watching several in one sitting is called binge-watching.
quests.textToSpeak: We watched three episodes of the show in one evening.
quests.question: We watched three _____ of the show in one evening.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What wireless connection lets your phone access the internet?
quests.explanation: Wifi lets phones and laptops connect to the internet without cables. 'Too slow to load' is a common modern complaint.
quests.textToSpeak: The wifi in the cafe was too slow to load the page.
quests.question: The _____ in the cafe was too slow to load the page.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a body temperature higher than normal due to illness?
quests.explanation: A fever is a sign the body is fighting an infection. 'Stayed home' is the sensible response to this symptom.
quests.textToSpeak: The child had a fever and stayed home from school.
quests.question: The child had a _____ and stayed home from school.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What written text at the bottom of the screen translates speech?
quests.explanation: Subtitles help viewers follow a film in another language. They're a useful tool for language learners too.
quests.textToSpeak: She turned on the subtitles to understand the foreign film.
quests.question: She turned on the _____ to understand the foreign film.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word means saving a file from the internet to your device?
quests.explanation: Download means to save something from the internet onto your device — the opposite of 'upload.'
quests.textToSpeak: It only takes a minute to download the app.
quests.question: It only takes a minute to _____ the app.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What strip of cloth protects a wound while it heals?
quests.explanation: A bandage protects an injury while it heals. 'Wrapped around' describes exactly how it's applied.
quests.textToSpeak: He wrapped a bandage around his injured ankle.
quests.question: He wrapped a _____ around his injured ankle.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What practice session happens before a real performance?
quests.explanation: A rehearsal lets performers practice before the real show. 'Opening night' is the exciting first public performance.
quests.textToSpeak: The actors had one final rehearsal before opening night.
quests.question: The actors had one final _____ before opening night.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes the connection strength of a phone?
quests.explanation: Signal describes how strong a phone's connection is. Tunnels often block it completely.
quests.textToSpeak: I couldn't call you because there was no signal in the tunnel.
quests.question: I couldn't call you because there was no _____ in the tunnel.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What natural substance in food keeps your body healthy?
quests.explanation: Vitamins are nutrients your body needs in small amounts to stay healthy. Oranges are especially linked with vitamin C.
quests.textToSpeak: Oranges are well known for their high vitamin content.
quests.question: Oranges are well known for their high _____ content.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What special clothing helps an actor look like their character?
quests.explanation: A costume helps an actor look like the character they're playing. School plays are a classic place to see creative costumes.
quests.textToSpeak: She wore a colorful costume for the school play.
quests.question: She wore a colorful _____ for the school play.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What set of buttons do you use to type on a computer?
quests.explanation: A keyboard is used to type letters into a computer. 'A few keys' shows only part of it was broken.
quests.textToSpeak: A few keys on his keyboard stopped working.
quests.question: A few keys on his _____ stopped working.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes the usual food a person eats?
quests.explanation: A diet describes what someone regularly eats, not just a weight-loss plan. 'Healthy diet' is a very common phrase.
quests.textToSpeak: Eating more vegetables is part of a healthy diet.
quests.question: Eating more vegetables is part of a healthy _____.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What sound do many people make by clapping their hands?
quests.explanation: Applause shows appreciation after a performance. 'Loud applause' suggests the audience really enjoyed the show.
quests.textToSpeak: The performance ended with loud applause from the crowd.
quests.question: The performance ended with loud _____ from the crowd.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What is a saved image of exactly what's on your screen called?
quests.explanation: A screenshot captures whatever is on your screen at that moment. It's a quick way to share a problem with someone.
quests.textToSpeak: He took a screenshot of the error message.
quests.question: He took a _____ of the error message.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a sign that a person may be ill?
quests.explanation: A symptom is a clue your body gives that something is wrong. Recognizing early symptoms can help you rest sooner.
quests.textToSpeak: A sore throat is often the first symptom of a cold.
quests.question: A sore throat is often the first _____ of a cold.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: Who is in charge of the creative decisions on a film set?
quests.explanation: A director controls the creative decisions behind a film, including whether to reshoot a scene. Producers handle the business side instead.
quests.textToSpeak: The director decided to reshoot the final scene.
quests.question: The _____ decided to reshoot the final scene.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What short alert message appears on your phone screen?
quests.explanation: A notification alerts you to a new message or update. Constant notifications during meetings are a common distraction.
quests.textToSpeak: Her phone buzzed with another notification during the meeting.
quests.question: Her phone buzzed with another _____ during the meeting.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What written instruction lets you buy certain medicine?
quests.explanation: A prescription is required for medicine not available over the counter. 'Stronger painkillers' shows the first treatment wasn't enough.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor wrote a prescription for stronger painkillers.
quests.question: The doctor wrote a _____ for stronger painkillers.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.

quests.hint: What word describes a film that continues an earlier story?
quests.explanation: A sequel continues a story that audiences already love. 'Waiting years' shows just how excited fans have been.
quests.textToSpeak: Fans have been waiting years for the sequel to come out.
quests.question: Fans have been waiting years for the _____ to come out.
quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the missing word.
